sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
sources.evidence: June 30, 2026 announcement names Claude Sonnet 5, identifies the claude-sonnet-5 API model, and states availability from that day. It describes planning and browser/terminal tool use.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact current model page lists June 30, 2026 release, 1M-token context, adaptive thinking, text/image input and text output. Status is Active (legacy).

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and extracted with pdftotext after browser access failed. Section 1 identifies the Sonnet-class Anthropic model and text-only output; section 1.4 distinguishes final and earlier snapshots. Section 6.6.1 discusses residual-stream probes without specifying architecture. Section 8.10.1 evaluates exact Sonnet 5 with base64 PDF inputs. Full-text inspection found no production parameter count or explicit architecture.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable. Used for the distribution policy, not to infer architecture.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Service terms grant permission to use Anthropic services and reserve intellectual-property rights except as expressly stated. Together with the explicit nonpublic-weight policy this supports descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: Current documentation says all active models support PDF processing. It describes extraction of document text and conversion of each page to an image; the exact Sonnet 5 page identifies it as Active (legacy).

sources.title: Tool use with Claude
sources.evidence: Official function-calling documentation names Claude Sonnet 5 in its tool-use token table, with auto/none and any/tool tool_choice settings. The original exact-model card also documents programmatic tool-calling evaluations.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Sonnet 5 summary
sources.evidence: Exact Sonnet 5 section confirms its identity and text/image inputs. The Model architecture and training methodology section describes pretraining/post-training without architectural or parameter details. Speech features are described as voice dictation and text-to-speech; the exact model specifications and system card state text-only model output.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full later PDF downloaded and extracted. Inspected its many exact Sonnet 5 comparisons and architecture/parameter terminology. No total/active production count or architecture for Sonnet 5 is disclosed; parameter mentions describe effort settings.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full later PDF downloaded and extracted. Exact Sonnet 5 comparisons concern evaluations and safeguards; no production parameter count or architecture for Sonnet 5 is supplied.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full later PDF downloaded and extracted. Exact Sonnet 5 comparisons disclose no production count or architecture. NLA/template-lens and layer discussions describe the assessed Opus model, not a Sonnet 5 architecture disclosure.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full later PDF downloaded and extracted after browser content-length failure. Exact Sonnet 5 comparisons supply evaluation results rather than production parameter or architecture disclosures. Natural-language-autoencoder analysis is not an exact Sonnet 5 architectural specification.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 System Card
sources.evidence: Full later PDF downloaded and extracted after browser content-length failure. Inspected exact Sonnet 5 comparisons and parameter/architecture references; found no total or active model-size or architecture disclosure for Sonnet 5.

name.note: Exact official display name and API identifier.

developer.note: Section 1 identifies the model as developed by Anthropic.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the exact Sonnet-class designation.

release_date.note: Dated announcement says available from that day; current specifications agree. This is launch timing rather than a training snapshot date.

open_weights.note: Explicit nonpublic Claude-weight policy applies to the model; hosted access is separately confirmed.

license.note: Descriptive classification of a nonpublic-weight service offered under commercial terms, not the name of an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total production parameter count found in the complete exact-model card, current transparency entry, or inspected later comparison cards. Targeted primary-source exact-name parameter and architecture searches found no disclosure. Prices and relative model size do not establish a count.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-per-token production count found in the inspected exact-model and later comparison sources. Evaluation effort parameters and interpretability-tool sizes do not establish active model parameters.

architecture.note: No explicit production architecture found in inspected sources. Residual-stream probing in the exact card is insufficient to identify Transformer or dense/MoE structure. No architecture is transferred from other Claude models or earlier snapshots; interpretability-tool dimensions and normalized layers are not model dimensions.

modalities.note: Specifications state text/image input and text output. Sonnet 5 was directly evaluated with base64 PDF inputs; PDF is a document format processed as text and page images. App-level dictation/text-to-speech does not add native audio modalities.

reasoning.note: Dedicated adaptive thinking is documented and enabled by default; this is not inferred from chain-of-thought prompting.

tool_call.note: Exact Sonnet 5 appears in the official function-calling support table; the card reports programmatic tool calling.

description.value: Claude Sonnet model with adaptive thinking and a 1M-token context window.
description.note: Neutral summary of directly documented model features.

patch.notes: Total and active production parameter counts and architecture remain undisclosed after inspecting the full Sonnet 5 card, current documentation, and later exact-name comparison cards. Proprietary describes nonpublic weights accessed under commercial service terms. PDF input is document processing through text and vision; output is text.

summary: Assessed all 14 fields: 11 verified and 3 undisclosed. Confirms June 30 launch, 1M context, text/image/PDF input, text output, adaptive thinking and tool calling. Adds proprietary classification and primary-source provenance, replaces the description with neutral documented features, and retains null parameter and architecture fields after full-card and later-comparison checks.
